newsitem.title: UK: LME copper touch easier in late trade, zinc steady.
newsitem.headline: LME copper touch easier in late trade, zinc steady.

text.p: LME copper eased a touch in late inter-office trading on Monday evening, while zinc held steady near the day's highs.
At 1800 GMT, three months copper was indicated at $2,342/45, down slightly from last kerb business at $2,353.
The market was hit by heavy overhead selling during the day after stocks rose by 3,900 tonnes and prices failed to challenge the $2,400 area.
Zinc was indicated at $1,669/72, little changed from a $1,671 kerb close after hitting a fresh seven-year peak of $1,674.
Aluminium was barely firmer at $1,691/94 compared to $1,690 at the kerb close.
